recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-panel composition featuring a vibrant red upper half with heavy, stylized display typography and a lower half containing a desaturated, grainy photograph of a five-piece band in formal attire walking through a wooded area.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal bisecting line separating graphic text from photographic subject
Color-coded hierarchy using blue-on-yellow for the primary title against a red field
Contrast between the rigid, geometric letterforms and the organic, textured background of the photo
Repetition of vertical figures in the lower half mirroring the verticality of the condensed text above
coreInvariants: Primary red background for the top section
Heavy black condensed sans-serif for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band members are positioned in the lower third, scaled to appear as full-length figures walking left to right. The primary title dominates the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized, blue-filled display word in the upper center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan: starting at the large title, moving through the dense list of tracks, and landing on the band members walking across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the layout is dense with information and visual texture, though the red field provides a flat breathing space for the text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blue and Black (Text and photo shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the top half contrasts with the muted, earthy tones and low-saturation greens/browns of the bottom photograph.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric slab and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, blocky strokes with sharp interior angles
Secondary text uses ultra-condensed, high-waisted sans-serif forms
Tertiary text uses wide, extended geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title characters feature a double outline (yellow then black) over a blue fill
The 'S' characters in the title have a distinctive horizontal middle bar with sharp diagonal terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide display paired with ultra-condensed body text.
graphicDevices: Framed logo box in upper right

preserve: The double outline on the main title
The condensed nature of the tracklist

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and condensed nature of the secondary text block
Matches the wide geometric 'STEREO' text at the top

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. The top half is a solid, slightly weathered vibrant red. The bottom half is a grainy, 1960s-style film photograph of five men in dark suits and skinny ties walking through a dark, brushy forest, carrying musical instruments like a saxophone and a drum.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, wide block-letter title in the center of the red section with blue fill and yellow/black outlines. Below it, typeset a dense block of text using an ultra-condensed black sans-serif font, separated by small square bullets.

verificationChecks: Is the red section exactly on the top half?
Does the main title have a yellow outline?
Is the tracklist text extremely condensed?
Is the photograph grainy and desaturated?

avoid: Vibrant green foliage in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the photo
Check that the red is not too orange or pink
Verify the band members look like they are from the early 1960s
Confirm the title font is significantly wider than the body font
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen layout + [Primary Color] top + [Vintage Photo] bottom + [Wide Display Font] + [Condensed Body Font] = Retro Album Aesthetic
